title: Legal Safeguards Against Workplace Harassment: Evaluating Implementation Of The Posh Act
journal: International Journal of Judicial Science Research Studies (IJJSRS)
abstract: The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act) represents a landmark legislative framework designed to protect women from workplace harassment in India. This paper critically evaluates the implementation efficacy of the POSH Act over the past decade, analyzing the gap between legislative intent and practical enforcement. Through examination of Supreme Court directives, compliance data, and implementation challenges, this study reveals significant shortcomings in the actualization of the Act's provisions. The research identifies systemic obstacles including widespread non-compliance, inadequate awareness, delayed justice mechanisms, and institutional deficiencies. Analysis of 300 National Stock Exchange-listed companies demonstrates that reporting remains concentrated among a limited number of organizations, suggesting poor compliance across sectors. Supreme Court interventions in 2023-2024 have attempted to address these implementation gaps through comprehensive directions to state and union governments. The paper argues that while the POSH Act provides robust legal safeguards on paper, its transformative potential remains unrealized due to enforcement failures, institutional inadequacies, and cultural resistance. The study concludes that effective implementation requires not merely structural compliance but fundamental shifts in organizational culture, enhanced training mechanisms, and rigorous monitoring frameworks.

title: МОТИВ ПИСЬМА И ПРОБЛЕМА КОММУНИКАЦИИ В «ЗАМКЕ» Ф. КАФКИ И «ЧУМЕ» А. КАМЮ
journal: Eurasian Journal of Social Sciences Philosophy and Culture
abstract: В статье рассматривается, как мотив письма и связанные с ним каналы связи организуют образ мира в романе Ф. Кафки «Замок» и в романе А. Камю «Чума». На основе коммуникативной схемы Р.О. Якобсона и нарративных категорий Ж. Женетта показано, что у Кафки абсурд возникает из избытка каналов связи при отсутствии гарантированного смысла, а у Камю из недостатка каналов при сохранности смысла. Различие определяет два типа «языка абсурда»: язык бюрократической избыточности и язык свидетельства.

title: Uncertainty and Real Estate Return Predictability: Evidence from U.S. REITs
journal: The Journal of Real Estate Finance and Economics
abstract: Abstract We show that fluctuations in financial uncertainty generate substantial and predictable variation in U.S. real estate returns. Using six real estate return series and a comprehensive set of predictors, we document strong forecasting performance both in-sample and out-of-sample, with out-of-sample $$R^2$$ exceeding 8%. A one standard deviation increase in financial uncertainty is associated with an approximately 1.5% decline in next-month REIT returns. To uncover the mechanisms behind this predictability, we apply the Campbell–Shiller present-value decomposition, which separates unexpected returns into cash-flow news, capturing revisions to expected future earnings, and discount-rate news, capturing revisions to expected returns. These components are derived from a parsimonious VAR that includes asset-specific dividend–price ratios, allowing us to trace the information content of financial uncertainty. The evidence reveals that financial uncertainty is associated primarily with negative cash-flow news, rather than innovations in expected returns. Relative to the aggregate stock market, real estate assets respond more strongly and persistently to uncertainty shocks, potentially reflecting both information frictions and delayed changes in underlying real estate fundamentals. In line with these findings, simple forecast-based strategies deliver economically meaningful gains, with annualized utility improvements exceeding 10%.

title: Trends in Intracerebral Versus Subarachnoid Hemorrhage Mortality and Between-Group Differences Among US Adults Aged 25 Years and Older, 1999–2020: A CDC WONDER Analysis
Tingkat Kepatuhan SOP (Standar Operasional Prosedur) GAP (Good Agricultural Practices) Petani Cabai Merah Keriting di Desa Ampreng Kecematan Langowan Barat Kabupaten Minahasa
journal: Journal of Agribusiness and Rural Development (Jurnal Agribisnis dan Pengembangan Pedesaan)
abstract: This study aims to assess the compliance level of curly red chili farmers with the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) of Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) in Ampreng Village, West Langowan Subdistrict, Minahasa Regency. The research employed a descriptive method using structured questionnaires and in-depth interviews. A total of 75 respondents were selected through accidental sampling from 124 farmers. Compliance was measured across seven cultivation stages (from land preparation to financial management) using a nominal scale (Yes/No) and categorized as high (≥75%), medium (50–74%), and low (<50%). The analysis included descriptive statistics, t-tests for productivity, and Chi-Square tests for relationships with respondents’ characteristics. Overall, 64% of farmers demonstrated high compliance with GAP SOPs, with the highest compliance observed in irrigation/fertilization (89.33%) and the lowest in land preparation (26.67%). Productivity in the high-compliance group (34.47 tons/ha) was significantly higher than in the low-compliance group (22.71 tons/ha). Land ownership status had a significant effect on compliance, whereas age, education, and farming experience did not. Consistent application of GAP SOPs improved chili productivity. Intensive technical assistance is needed for farmers with medium or low compliance, particularly during the land preparation stage, to support sustainable farming and increased yields. This study provides a basis for developing a more optimized agricultural system in the area.
